metadata.title: Velyric – the AI voice agent that answers every call
metadata.description: Velyric's AI voice agent answers your calls day and night in English, German and Hungarian, books appointments, and hands over to your team when needed.

brand.tagline: AI voice agents for modern businesses

hero.eyebrow: AI voice agents for modern businesses
hero.titleLine2: day and night, in your language.
hero.subtitle: Velyric's voice agent picks up the phone like your best receptionist: friendly, natural, and it books the appointment right away. You stay focused on your work.

personal.title: We come to you and build it around your business.
personal.text: Every business is different. That's why we don't install a template: together we plan what it says, what it knows and when it hands over.

footer.tagline: AI voice agents for modern businesses. Day and night.

noCalls.title: The assistant doesn't answer calls
steps: Check that your number is forwarded to your Velyric line (see “How do I forward my number?”).
Under Assistant → Tasks, check when it should answer: always, outside opening hours, or when you can't.
Call your own number from another phone and watch the Live calls card.
Still nothing? Write to us — we'll look into it right away.
noCalls.where: In the Assistant menu you set when and what it does.

forward.title: How do I forward my number?
steps: Our colleague gives you your Velyric number during onboarding.
Always: dial **21*Velyric number# and press call.
Only when busy: **67*Velyric number# · When unanswered: **61*Velyric number#.
To turn off: ##002#. For landlines or company PBX, your provider will help.

wrongAnswer.title: It gave a wrong or inaccurate answer
steps: Look at the call transcript in Calls to see what was asked.
Under Assistant → Knowledge base, upload the correct information (price list, FAQ) or add it under “Anything else it should know”.
If it was a medical, legal or personal question, the assistant transfers on purpose — that's correct.
wrongAnswer.where: Extend what it knows under Assistant → Knowledge base.

hours.title: Only answer outside opening hours
steps: Open Assistant → Tasks.
Under “When should it answer?”, choose “Outside opening hours”.
Add your exact opening hours on the Knowledge base tab.
hours.where: Set it on the Assistant → Tasks tab.

issues.title: What does an open item mean?
steps: After every call the AI extracts what a person still needs to do: a callback, an open question, a complaint.
When it's done, click “Resolved” / “Done”.
You can replay the source call with one click.
issues.where: All open and closed items are here.

look.title: How do I change the look?
steps: Settings → Appearance.
Choose a style, dark or light mode and a colour — you see it instantly.
Here you can also toggle and reorder the homepage cards.

invoice.title: Where are my invoices?
steps: Settings → Billing.
“Invoices and card” takes you to Stripe's secure page: download invoices, change your card or cancel the subscription.

data.title: How do I download or delete my data?
steps: Settings → Privacy.
“Download my data” gives you all your data in one file.
Deleting the account is permanent: all calls, transcripts, settings and uploaded files are deleted and the subscription ends.

security.title: Turn on two-step verification
steps: Install an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password).
Settings → Security → “Turn on”, then scan the QR code.
Enter the 6-digit code. From then on we'll ask for it at every sign-in.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: You decide how long we keep call data, and you can download or delete it at any time.
privacy.retentionText: After this period the transcript, caller name and number are deleted automatically. Statistics remain.
privacy.exportText: Get all your data in one JSON file: setup, calls, transcripts, items, bookings.
privacy.deleteText: All your data — calls, transcripts, settings, uploaded files — is deleted permanently and the subscription ends.
privacy.deleteWarning: This can't be undone. After deletion the assistant will no longer answer your calls.
privacy.typeEmail: To confirm, type your email address: {email}
privacy.deleteError: Couldn't delete just now. Write to us and we'll handle it right away.
